<!-- pr-reviewer: aa13a6f3e25ea7aeda6ef6d20c19d14ea0345455 -->

**Verdict: merge-ready.** Second look under the safety floor, independent of the author. Built on a merged tree (head aa13a6f3e + main; the trial merge is clean).

Evidence run here:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test adaptive_zero_margin_island`: 4 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test keep_law`: 31 passed, 0 failed. The gouge pins (`...offset_into_the_part_gouges_and_never_posts`, all sources and variants) hold: the extension cannot flood an island.

Code reading: `blocked` is now the union of the part's overhead silhouette over the step ladder, so `extension` grows only the exterior clears and a manual offset into the part still rides `DepthLaw::Keep` - the two laws stay separated correctly. `unreached_corners` reports the cusps inside reached pieces, clips them against the stock footprint so air outside the stock says nothing, and filters arc noise at 0.03 mm half-width; the refactor of `unreached_pieces` keeps its old behaviour, and the existing narrow-band pins stay green. The note never blocks; a corner check that cannot run logs a warning instead of hiding - visible refusal or visible note, never silence (Prime Directive). `op_view` adds `notes` only when non-empty, so empty MCP responses are byte-identical. The decision record is complete.

The two reds your base check names (`shoulder_adaptive` timer under load; `stock_source_holes` framed chamfer hint from #2450) are ledgered on #2483 - neither is from this PR.

Labels: `merge-ready` stands as the author set it; this comment adds the independent marker.
